**Test build 2** of Nexo v0.4 beta. Only friends on test builds get it; everyone else stays on the regular
releases.

## Fixed

- **Full-screen games show up in the share dialog.** A full-screen game minimizes itself when you alt-tab
  to Nexo, and the dialog used to leave minimized windows out (found with CS2). They're now listed with
  the game's icon and a **Minimized** badge. Pick it, start sharing, then switch back to the game: the
  stream starts as soon as the game is on screen. Until then your live card says "Window minimized".
- Sharing a game that was minimized at the start no longer fails: the stream uses the game's real size.

## Please try

Everything from [test build 1](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/releases/tag/v0.4.0-test.1), plus:
share a full-screen game you alt-tabbed out of, and tell us whether viewers see it once you're back in.

## Install

Already on test build 1? Nothing to do: Nexo updates itself (or **Settings → App → Check for updates**).

New tester? Download `Nexo-Setup-0.4.0-test.2.exe` from the **Assets** below and run it over your current
Nexo. Your settings and login stay. SmartScreen may warn: **More info → Run anyway**.

To go back to the regular releases: **Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart Nexo.
